column1: WHEREAS the office of member of Rathnapura Municiple Council has fallen vacant by reason of resignation;
And whereas the secretary of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna, the recognized political party to which Nanimi
Arachchige Don Darshana Chamath Gunawardhana the member belonged, was required by me under section 66A (1)(a) of
the aforesaid ordinance, to decide upon the member of that Word Number 09 Godigamuwa of Rathnapura Municiple Council
who  belongs  to  such  party  and  is  not  disqualified  under  section  9  of  the  local  authorities  elections  ordinance
(Chapter 262) and who shall be declared elected as a member within a period of thirty (30) days ;
And whereas the secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has communicated his decision to nominate
Nanimi Arachchige Don Kapila Gunawardhana to fill such vacancy;
Therefore I, Suranga Ambagahathenne, returning officer of the Rathnapura Municiple Council, acting in terms of
section 66A (1)(a) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declare that Nanimi Arachchige
Don  Kapila  Gunawardhana  was  selected  as  the  member  of  the  Word  Number  09  Godigamuva  of  Rathnapura  Miniciple
